description: Protocol types and crypto primitives for universal seal/open encryption. Adds SealedMessage wire format with nonce/AAD, HKDF key derivation for K_enc/K_auth from roomSecret, HMAC signing for ECDH public keys, session key mixing, and seal/open functions with replay rejection tracking. Independent of all other features — establishes the cryptographic foundation.
steps: Read docs/BRIEF.md §11.3 E2EE spec and context.json for existing crypto patterns

Add SealedMessage type to packages/protocol/src/index.ts: {from: string, to: string|null, nonce: string (base64 sid||counter), ciphertext: string (base64), tag: string (base64)}. Add AAD type: {from, to, type, timestamp}. Add SignedPublicKey type: {publicKey: JsonWebKey, signature: string (base64 HMAC)}. Remove old EncryptedEnvelope type.

Add deriveRoomKeys(roomSecret: Uint8Array) to apps/web/src/lib/crypto.ts: uses HKDF-SHA-256 with salt='matinee-room', info='enc' to derive K_enc (32 bytes), info='auth' to derive K_auth (32 bytes). Returns {kEnc: CryptoKey, kAuth: CryptoKey}.
Add signPublicKey(publicKeyJwk: JsonWebKey, kAuth: CryptoKey) to crypto.ts: HMAC-SHA-256(kAuth, JSON.stringify(publicKeyJwk)) returns base64 signature.
Add verifyPublicKey(publicKeyJwk: JsonWebKey, signature: string, kAuth: CryptoKey) to crypto.ts: recompute HMAC, compare constant-time (btoa match).

Add mixSessionKey(ecdhSecret: ArrayBuffer, kEnc: CryptoKey) to crypto.ts: exportKey(kEnc) as raw bytes, concat ecdhSecret||kEncBytes, HKDF with salt='matinee-session' to derive final AES-GCM-256 session key.

Add seal(sessionKey: CryptoKey, payload: unknown, aad: AAD, sessionId: Uint8Array, counter: bigint) to crypto.ts: nonce = sessionId (4 bytes) || counter (8 bytes BE), AAD = JSON.stringify(aad), AES-GCM-256 encrypt JSON.stringify(payload), return SealedMessage with base64 nonce/ciphertext/tag.

Add open(sessionKey: CryptoKey, sealed: SealedMessage) to crypto.ts: decode nonce/ciphertext/tag from base64, AAD from sealed metadata {from, to, type: extract from ciphertext after decrypt or store in envelope}, AES-GCM decrypt, parse JSON payload, return {payload, counter: extract from nonce}.

Add ReplayTracker class to crypto.ts: tracks Map<peerId, bigint> lastSeenCounter, reject(peerId, counter) returns boolean (true if replay: counter <= lastSeen or gap > 1000), update(peerId, counter) stores new lastSeen.
Update existing deriveSharedSecret to call mixSessionKey internally (preserve existing API but add roomSecret param for K_enc mixing).
acceptance_criteria: SealedMessage, AAD, SignedPublicKey types exported from @matinee/protocol
deriveRoomKeys produces two distinct 32-byte keys with correct HKDF parameters
signPublicKey and verifyPublicKey correctly sign/verify JWK objects
seal/open round-trip preserves payload for all message types
ReplayTracker correctly rejects duplicate and out-of-order counters
TypeScript typecheck passes: cd packages/protocol && pnpm run typecheck
verification: cd packages/protocol && pnpm run typecheck — no errors
cd packages/protocol && pnpm build — dist/ generated
cd apps/web && pnpm run typecheck — no errors (crypto.ts imports protocol types)
findings: All acceptance criteria met. Note: AAD reconstruction in open() currently uses placeholder timestamp and empty type field. FEAT-002 must ensure AAD metadata (type, timestamp) is preserved in the wire envelope or derived from message context for proper verification.
